label: prf:genus-filtration-ideal
title: Proof of genus-filtration ideal characterisation
html:
Proof. Proof of genus-filtration ideal characterisation

Proof. The argument decomposes into four steps. By (genus from Hecke completeness), g = 4 is the least genus at which the embeddable torus knots number at least the five irreducibles of H_2(q) \oplus H_3(q) -- a count, not a spanning statement (the block-rank remark), so g = 4 is taken as given here. By (Chebyshev degree = Seifert genus), the Hecke recurrence a_{n+1} = s\,a_n + a_{n-1} produces \deg_u a_p = (p-1)/2 = g(T_{2,p}) in the variable u = s^2, with leading coefficient 1. By (genus-filtration ideal characterisation), the truncation \pi_4 \colon \mathbb{Z}[u] \to \mathbb{Z}[u]/(u^5) has kernel \mathfrak{I}_4 = (u^5), identified with the Seifert cycles that have no target in H_1(\Sigma_4). Finally, by (Yekutieli leading coefficient), the obstruction \kappa(T_{2,p}) at level n = 5 equals the leading Chebyshev coefficient c_{(p-1)/2} = 1, which is nonzero for q \neq 1. Both characterisations therefore agree. \square
